meta.title: 2FA Backup Code Generator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Generate one-time 2FA backup codes for emergency login when two-factor authentication becomes unavailable.
desc: Generate one-time 2FA backup codes for emergency login when two-factor authentication becomes unavailable.
ui.5: backup codes. Store them somewhere safe now
ui.100: Count must be an integer between 1 and 50
ui.101: Length must be an integer between 4 and 32
ui.102: Backup codes are generated only once, so print them or save them in a password manager right away. The charset excludes easily confused characters such as 0/O/1/l/I, and codes are grouped in blocks of 4 for easier copying.
